heading: Expiration of program
lead: No new contract for flood insurance under this chapter shall be entered into after September 30, 2026.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This chapter, referred to in text, was in the original a reference to “this title” meaning title XIII of Pub. L. 90–448, Aug. 1, 1968, 82 Stat. 572, known as the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968, which is classified principally to this chapter. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title note set out under section 4001 of this title and Tables.
